[attribute-collab-type]
=== `@collab-type` Type of Collaboration

Type or role of the collaborators; what function they played in the publication (for example, “`translators`”, “`editors`”).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-collab,`<collab>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Word or phrase that describes the role that the collaborators played in the
                        publication, for example, “`Working-Group`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
